arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Stewart argued the statute uses the word discovery without specifying actual or constructive knowledge.
Mr. Frederick argued Congress intended the word discovery to have its normal and well-established meaning.
Mr. Shanmugam argued the statute incorporates the equitable principle that the period begins upon discovery of facts.
Justice Roberts asked what phrase describes when inquiry notice culminates in finding out about scienter.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the meaning of the word discovery in a federal statute. The term controls when a two-year deadline begins for private securities fraud suits. The parties disagree on whether the term means actual knowledge or constructive knowledge.
